correctness.rationale: Under the exact Wang–Xu–Zhu coupled Laplace equation, the implicit inverse is analytic at zero. Differentiation gives a finite signed-derivative recurrence indexed by labeled target positions; its complete mathematical formula appears in RESULT.md. The matrix \(J=(B^{\mathsf T})^{-1}\) is nonnegative, has strictly positive diagonal, and has strictly positive \(J_{ij}\) precisely on directed paths from \(i\) to \(j\). Induction proves the signed derivative \(H_i(S)\) is positive iff its root reaches every named target. Summing with positive \(\eta_i\) yields the cumulant criterion. The Lévy–Khintchine identity for orders \(r\ge2\) converts positive cumulants into positive simultaneous-jump support; vanishing cross-jump masses is equivalent to independence of projected Lévy subprocesses. The six-type nilpotent example has all three pair covariances equal to \(t/25\) and zero triple cumulant. Included independent polynomial and derivative recursions pass 1,588 counted exact cases; finite checks only corroborate the unrestricted proof. Necessity of \(\eta>0\), \(t>0\) and the special quadratic exponent is stated.

value.rationale: This is a complete, natural finite-dimensional dependence classification for an emerging coupled IG Lévy family: it identifies every simultaneous positive-coordinate jump face and every pair/group independence relation without calculating a multivariate Lévy density. The all-order exact recursion reveals information not available from pair correlations. The six-type example has three positive pairwise covariances but zero triple common shocks, a motivated and substantive boundary that illustrates why covariance-graph information is insufficient. It uses the full nonsingular M-matrix class, including reducible directed graphs, not an arbitrary narrow numerical slice. The work is analytically self-contained given the published Laplace premise and does not claim a general theorem for unrelated Hawkes models.
